    Install the desktop application

    The first public desktop release is pending. Once published, download it from GitHub Releases (online).

    Windows

    The Windows distribution targets Windows 11 x64. Choose one release asset:

    Asset Installation
    MultiSolid-<version>-windows-x64-setup.exe Run the installer, then open MultiSolid from the Start menu. Installation is for the current user.
    MultiSolid-<version>-windows-x64-portable.zip Extract the entire ZIP into a new folder, then run MultiSolid/MultiSolid.exe. Keep its files and subfolders together.

    Linux

    The Linux distribution targets Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64. Choose one release asset:

    Asset Installation
    MultiSolid-<version>-linux-x64-setup.deb Run sudo apt install ./MultiSolid-<version>-linux-x64-setup.deb, then open MultiSolid from the applications menu.
    MultiSolid-<version>-linux-x64-portable.tar.gz Extract the entire archive, then run ./MultiSolid/MultiSolid. Keep its files and subfolders together.

    The installer adds the multisolid command and installs under /opt/multisolid. Remove it with sudo apt remove multisolid. Other Linux distributions are not qualified by the Ubuntu build.

    Projects and updates

    The desktop distributions include Python, DAETools, Graphviz, and the compiler and libraries needed for Compiled execution. You do not need to install these separately. GitHub's automatically generated source archives contain source code; choose an installer or portable archive for the ready-to-run application.

    Create projects in a writable folder outside the application directory. The first Compiled run may take several minutes to build its model; compatible later runs reuse the project's cache. To update a portable installation, extract the new version into a new folder and open your existing project.

    Follow Getting started to create and run your first case, or use the GUI guide for the full project workflow.
